title: Title slide: Fall of Man (part 5)
summary: Opening title slide of the Fall of Man lesson, a video still of the presenter sitting on a couch in front of a world map, with the green title “Fall of Man” and the number 5.

numbers.note: number shown under the title (lesson/part number in the series)

pictures.description: Video still of the presenter, a man with glasses in a white T-shirt, seated on a brown couch with his hand raised to his face, in front of a large wall map of the world showing the Americas, the Atlantic Ocean and Africa. The green title text “Fall of Man” and a large green “5” are overlaid at the lower left.
